Book on roles of artists in 1971 launched
2015-01-24T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/book-on-roles-of-artists-in-1971-launched-61461

A book titled “Bangladesher Swadhinata Sangrame Shilpi Samaj” (roles of artists in Bangladesh's Liberation War), written by artist Biren Som, was launched at the capital's BCS Proshason Academy yesterday.

Chandrabati Academy organised the ceremony of the book's publication, sponsored by the Investment Corporation of Bangladesh.

Finance Minister AMA Muhith addressed the programme as chief guest with Prof Emeritus of Dhaka University Anisuzzaman in the chair.

Artists Mustafa Monowar and Rafiqun Nabi, the writer Biren, ICB Chairman Mujib Uddin Ahmed and its Managing Director Md Faequezzman, and Chandrabati Academy Executive Director Kamruzzaman Kajol, among others, spoke on the occasion.
